yearMeaning: Czech Military History Institute and Ministry of Defence report that 18 June has been a nationally recognized significant day since 2018; the commemorated battle took place in 1942.
authority: Czech Republic, significant day under Act No. 245/2000 Coll., as amended
dateReason: 18 June marks the final battle of seven Czechoslovak parachutists against Nazi forces at the Church of Saints Cyril and Methodius in Prague in 1942.

sourceEvidence.claim: Military History Institute, 18 June 2025: the 1942 church battle and annual Day of Heroes of the Second Resistance observed since 2018.
Ministry of Defence, 18 June 2024: details of the seven parachutists, church siege, local assistance and memorial designation since 2018.
Czech Ministry of Labour consolidated Act 245/2000, §4: 18 June is Den hrdinů druhého odboje, a significant working day.

narratives.en: Every 18 June, Czechia remembers the heroes of its Second Resistance, the struggle against Nazi occupation during the Second World War. The date recalls 18 June 1942, when seven Czechoslovak parachutists fought German forces at Prague's Church of Saints Cyril and Methodius, where they had taken refuge after the attack on Reinhard Heydrich. The commemoration also honours the civilians and clergy who supported the resistance and faced reprisals. The date became a Czech nationally recognized significant day in 2018, distinct from the wartime event in 1942.
narratives.it: Ogni 18 giugno la Repubblica Ceca ricorda gli eroi della seconda resistenza, impegnata contro l'occupazione nazista durante la Seconda guerra mondiale. La data richiama il 18 giugno 1942, quando sette paracadutisti cecoslovacchi combatterono contro le forze tedesche nella chiesa dei Santi Cirillo e Metodio a Praga, dove si erano rifugiati dopo l'attacco a Reinhard Heydrich. La commemorazione rende omaggio anche ai civili e al clero che aiutarono la resistenza e subirono rappresaglie. Il giorno fu riconosciuto ufficialmente come ricorrenza nazionale nel 2018, distinto dall'evento del 1942.
narratives.es: Cada 18 de junio, Chequia recuerda a los héroes de la Segunda Resistencia contra la ocupación nazi durante la Segunda Guerra Mundial. La fecha evoca el 18 de junio de 1942, cuando siete paracaidistas checoslovacos combatieron contra fuerzas alemanas en la iglesia de los Santos Cirilo y Metodio de Praga, donde se habían refugiado tras el ataque a Reinhard Heydrich. La conmemoración honra también a los civiles y religiosos que ayudaron a la resistencia y sufrieron represalias. El día recibió reconocimiento oficial como fecha significativa nacional en 2018, distinto del suceso de 1942.
narratives.fr: Chaque 18 juin, la Tchéquie honore les héros de la deuxième Résistance contre l'occupation nazie pendant la Seconde Guerre mondiale. Cette date rappelle le 18 juin 1942, lorsque sept parachutistes tchécoslovaques affrontèrent les forces allemandes dans l'église Saints-Cyrille-et-Méthode de Prague, où ils s'étaient réfugiés après l'attaque contre Reinhard Heydrich. La commémoration rend aussi hommage aux civils et aux religieux qui aidèrent la résistance et subirent des représailles. La journée est reconnue officiellement comme date nationale importante depuis 2018, distincte de l'événement de 1942.
narratives.de: Am 18. Juni erinnert Tschechien an die Helden des zweiten Widerstands gegen die nationalsozialistische Besatzung im Zweiten Weltkrieg. Das Datum geht auf den 18. Juni 1942 zurück, als sieben tschechoslowakische Fallschirmagenten in der Prager Kirche St. Cyrill und Method gegen deutsche Truppen kämpften. Dort hatten sie nach dem Anschlag auf Reinhard Heydrich Zuflucht gefunden. Der Gedenktag würdigt auch Zivilpersonen und Geistliche, die den Widerstand unterstützten und Repressalien erlitten. Seit 2018 ist er ein staatlich anerkannter bedeutender Tag; das historische Ereignis fand 1942 statt.
narratives.pt: A 18 de junho, a Chéquia homenageia os heróis da Segunda Resistência contra a ocupação nazi durante a Segunda Guerra Mundial. A data recorda 18 de junho de 1942, quando sete paraquedistas checoslovacos combateram forças alemãs na igreja dos Santos Cirilo e Metódio, em Praga, onde se tinham refugiado após o ataque a Reinhard Heydrich. A comemoração homenageia também civis e membros do clero que apoiaram a resistência e sofreram represálias. A data passou a ser oficialmente reconhecida como dia nacional significativo em 2018, distinto do acontecimento de 1942.
